address: Atlantis The Palm, 22nd Floor, Crescent Road, The Palm Jumeriah, Dubai
bio: In 2023 it relocated to a striking spot on the 22nd floor of Atlantis The Palm and ensured that this global brand continues to guarantee a fun and lively night out. So come with friends and order a range of Japanese dishes with South American influences. Choose from the hot and cold ‘Classic’ or ‘Now’ dishes – and don’t miss the signature black cod miso; for the ultimate experience, go for one of the two omakase menus....
